// productName: LOAD-BEARING — DO NOT CHANGE AFTER RELEASE. Electron derives app.getName() from this, and app.getPath('userData') derives from that. Changing it silently moves every user's database and settings to a new folder: tracked time, projects and tasks appear to vanish, with no error and no migration. Verified the hard way on 2026-07-29 — adding this field moved userData from %APPDATA%/@mochi/desktop to %APPDATA%/Mochi and split the local history in two.
